title: (AVR v2) NEW Supplier Booking Search SEARCH_NAVIGATE
description: Starting from the Welcomebeds.com account menu, opens the Ávoris back office, finds a booking by its locator, downloads its hotel voucher PDF, and parses it into structured booking details. v2: splits the single monolithic navigation into a verified checkpoint block plus a download block, and disambiguates the account-icon click that was previously confused with the language selector.

parameters.description: The Ávoris booking locator to look up (the value shown in the 'LOCATOR' column, e.g. '803166953').
The Welcomebeds.com homepage URL to start the run from (e.g. 'https://en.welcomebeds.com/').

blocks.label: Open_Booking_Documents
blocks.title: Open_Booking_Documents
blocks.navigation_goal:
*** OBJECTIVE: starting from the Welcomebeds.com homepage, reach the 'DOCUMENTATION / ATTACHMENTS' tab of the Ávoris booking detail page for booking reference '{{booking_id}}' ***

1. On the homepage, in the very top-right corner, click the small ROUND account/profile icon — a plain person-silhouette glyph with NO text label and NO dropdown chevron of its own. It sits immediately to the RIGHT of the 'English ⌄' language selector.
   - IMPORTANT — do NOT click the language selector. If clicking opens a list of language names (English, Español, Português, Français, Italiano, ...), you clicked the WRONG element: close that list and click further right, on the round person-icon, instead.
2. Confirm the correct dropdown opened: it shows an account number, an agency name, and the links 'Invoicing', 'Bookings', 'Sign Out'. If you instead see a language list, or nothing changed, retry step 1 — do not proceed until this exact dropdown is visible.
3. In that dropdown, click 'Bookings'. This opens the Ávoris back office 'Bookings and budgets' tool, possibly in a new tab — if a new tab opens, switch to it and continue there.
4. On the 'Reservations and budgets finder' page, click into the 'Booking reference' input (the first field in the filter form, top-left) and type '{{booking_id}}' into it. Leave every other filter field untouched.
5. Click the dark blue 'SEARCH' button at the bottom-right of the filter form.
6. Wait for the 'Search Result' table to appear below the form. Find the row whose 'LOCATOR' column equals '{{booking_id}}'.
7. In that row, click the 'Open reservation' icon — a small box-with-arrow icon at the right end of the row. Do not click the copy icon next to it.
8. The booking detail page opens with a green bar reading 'BOOKING LOCATOR: {{booking_id}}' at the top, and a tab strip below it (GENERAL INFORMATION, DETAIL OF SERVICES, PASSENGER DETAILS, DETAIL OF AMOUNTS, PAYMENT MANAGEMENT, DOCUMENTATION / ATTACHMENTS, CLAIMS). Click the 'DOCUMENTATION / ATTACHMENTS' tab.
9. Confirm that tab is open: it shows three buttons ('Journey information', 'Proforma invoice', 'Generate voucher') above a 'DOCUMENTS' table.

If a cookie-consent banner or modal covers the page at any point, dismiss it and carry on. If any click in this sequence lands somewhere unexpected (wrong menu, wrong tab, an error toast), do not treat that as final — re-orient from what is actually on screen and retry the step that went wrong instead of continuing forward from the wrong page.

### COMPLETE when
The green 'BOOKING LOCATOR: {{booking_id}}' bar AND the 'DOCUMENTATION / ATTACHMENTS' tab's 'DOCUMENTS' table (with a visible 'Generate voucher' button) are both visible on the page at the same time.

### TERMINATE if
- A login or sign-in form asking for both a username AND a password is displayed on welcomebeds.com or the Ávoris back office: the browser session is not authenticated. Do not attempt to log in yourself.
- After clicking SEARCH, the Search Result table is visible but contains no row whose LOCATOR equals '{{booking_id}}'.
blocks.complete_criterion: The green 'BOOKING LOCATOR: {{booking_id}}' bar is visible AND the 'DOCUMENTATION / ATTACHMENTS' tab is the active tab, showing a 'DOCUMENTS' table and a 'Generate voucher' button.
blocks.terminate_criterion: A login form with both a username field and a password field is visible on the current page, OR the Ávoris 'Search Result' table is visible with no row whose LOCATOR column equals '{{booking_id}}'.

error_code_mapping.not_authenticated: A login or sign-in form was displayed on welcomebeds.com or the Ávoris back office instead of the expected page, meaning the browser session is not logged in
error_code_mapping.booking_not_found: Filtering the Ávoris finder by the booking reference returned no matching row in the Search Result table, so the booking does not exist or is not visible to this account

blocks.label: Download_Voucher
blocks.title: Download_Voucher
blocks.navigation_goal:
*** OBJECTIVE: on the already-open 'DOCUMENTATION / ATTACHMENTS' tab of the Ávoris booking detail page, obtain and download the voucher PDF ***

1. Look at the 'Type' column of the 'DOCUMENTS' table on this tab.
   - If a row with Type 'Voucher' already exists, do NOT click 'Generate voucher' — skip straight to step 2.
   - If no row with Type 'Voucher' exists yet, click the 'Generate voucher' button and wait for the DOCUMENTS table to refresh and show a new row with Type 'Voucher'.
2. In the DOCUMENTS table, in the row with Type 'Voucher' (its Name is usually 'Travel documentation'), click the download icon in the Actions column — the down-arrow-into-tray icon. Do not click the magnifying-glass 'view' icon next to it.

### WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
The voucher is a PDF file. This browser is configured to save PDFs to disk instead of displaying them, so clicking the download icon starts a download rather than opening a readable page. A blank tab, a newly opened empty tab, or a download indicator IS the successful outcome — the block finishes on its own as soon as the file is saved.
- Do NOT wait for voucher details to render on screen, and do NOT treat a blank page as a failure.
- Do NOT click the download icon a second time; a repeat click only produces a duplicate file.
- If a cookie-consent banner or modal covers the page at any point, dismiss it and carry on.

### TERMINATE
- TERMINATE if the page currently on screen is not the 'DOCUMENTATION / ATTACHMENTS' tab described above (e.g. a login form, or an unrelated tab/page) — this block assumes the previous block already reached that tab, and does not attempt to navigate there itself.
- TERMINATE if clicking 'Generate voucher' produces an error message and no 'Voucher' row ever appears in the DOCUMENTS table.

error_code_mapping.wrong_page: The page on screen is not the DOCUMENTATION / ATTACHMENTS tab of the booking detail page, so the preceding navigation block did not actually reach it
error_code_mapping.voucher_not_available: The DOCUMENTATION / ATTACHMENTS tab was reached but no 'Voucher' document could be generated or downloaded

extracted_information.description: The booking details read from the voucher PDF, as an array containing exactly one object. Always return exactly one item here, never zero and never more than one.

hotelName.description: Name of the hotel. Source: the 'Hotel:' line inside the 'ACCOMMODATION' section (e.g. 'Hotel: The Royal National Hotel | Nights: : 6' -> 'The Royal National Hotel'). The same name is usually repeated in the 'BOOKING DETAILS' box's own 'Hotel:' row (top-right of the page); if the two differ, prefer the ACCOMMODATION section's value here and put the BOOKING DETAILS value in supplierHotelName. Never take a name from the AGENCY DETAILS box or from the page footer.
hotelName.title: Hotel Name

address.description: Full street address of the hotel. Source: the 'Address:' line inside the 'ACCOMMODATION' section, directly under the 'Hotel: ... | Nights: ...' and 'Category:' lines (street, number, city, postal code, region, country). Never use the AGENCY DETAILS address (top-left box, e.g. '3500 S. Dupont Hwy - Dover') — that belongs to the travel agency, not the hotel.
address.title: Address

checkinDate.description: Check-in date as ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Source: the 'Check-in date:' field inside the 'BOOKING DETAILS' box. Dates in this document are DD/MM/YY (e.g. '20/10/26' -> '2026-10-20'); the two-digit year is always in the 2000s. If the Rooms table's ARRIVAL column disagrees across multiple rows, still use the single 'Check-in date:' value from the BOOKING DETAILS box here.
checkinDate.title: Check-in Date

checkoutDate.description: Check-out date as ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Source: the 'Return date:' field inside the 'BOOKING DETAILS' box (e.g. '26/10/26' -> '2026-10-26'), same DD/MM/YY parsing as checkinDate. Never use 'Booking date:' or 'Notification date:' printed at the very top of the page — those are administrative dates, not the stay dates.
checkoutDate.title: Check-out Date

adultCount.description: Number of ADULT guests. Source: the 'Adults:' field inside the 'BOOKING DETAILS' box (e.g. 'Adults: 2'). Never derive this by counting rows in the CUSTOMER DETAILS table — that table has no Pax Type or age-category column, so it cannot reliably distinguish adults from children.
adultCount.title: Adult Count

guestNames.description: Guest names from the 'CUSTOMER DETAILS' table, one entry per row, taken verbatim from the 'Name' column (ignore the 'Age' column). Include every row with a name, adults and children alike. Output null if the table has no rows.
guestNames.title: Guest Names

childrenCount.description: Number of CHILD guests. Source: the 'Children:' field inside the BOOKING DETAILS box. Output null whenever that field reads '0' or is blank — never output 0.
childrenCount.title: Children Count

supplierHotelName.description: The hotel name as shown in the 'BOOKING DETAILS' box's own 'Hotel:' row (top-right of the page), filled ONLY when it differs from the hotelName extracted from the ACCOMMODATION section. Output null when the two match, or when the BOOKING DETAILS box has no Hotel row — never repeat the value of hotelName here.
supplierHotelName.title: Supplier Hotel Name

roomCategory.description: Room type, from the 'TYPE' column of the Rooms table under 'Rooms:' inside ACCOMMODATION (e.g. 'Double room on Room Only Basis'), copied verbatim, including any board-basis wording folded into that same column. If several rooms are listed, join the distinct values with '; '. Output null if the column is empty.
roomCategory.title: Room Category

mealPlan.description: Meal / board plan, from the 'BOARD BASIS' column of the Rooms table (e.g. 'Accommodation only'), copied verbatim. If several rooms are listed, join the distinct values with '; '. Output null if the column is empty.
mealPlan.title: Meal Plan

bedType.description: Bed configuration (e.g. Double, Twin, King), filled ONLY when the document states it explicitly in its own field. Never infer it from the room TYPE text — 'Double room' describes the room, not confirmed bedding. This voucher template does not carry a dedicated bed-type field, so this will normally be null.
bedType.title: Bed Type

phone.description: Hotel phone number, digits only. Source: the 'Phone' field inside the ACCOMMODATION section (e.g. 'GB 2076372488'). That value is a two-letter country marker followed by a local number, not a numeric calling code — strip the leading letters and every non-digit character, keeping only the digit run (e.g. 'GB 2076372488' -> '2076372488'). Never use the AGENCY DETAILS 'Phone number:' field or the '24-hour customer service' footer number — those belong to the agency, not the hotel. Output null if the ACCOMMODATION section carries no phone.
phone.title: Phone

ibn.description: Internal Booking Number — the definitive booking locator, printed at the top-right of the page directly under the 'CLIENT DOCUMENTATION' or 'HOTEL VOUCHER' heading (e.g. '803166953'). Never take it from the AGENCY DETAILS 'Reference:' row (a different, UUID-style agency reference, e.g. 'fbdc0380-178e-488a-ad6a-436f261602e8/7f8116') and never from the 'Agent:' row (the agency's own account number, e.g. '5123022687') — both belong to the agency, not to this booking's own locator. Output null if no such locator is printed on the page.
ibn.title: Internal Booking Number (IBN)

hcn.description: Hotel Confirmation Number, from the 'HCN:' row inside the BOOKING DETAILS box ONLY. In this template that row is normally blank — output null whenever it is empty. Never use the AGENCY DETAILS 'Agent:' row's account number (e.g. '5123022687') as HCN just because it is a similar-length numeric string — that is the agency's own account id, not a hotel confirmation. Never fall back to ibn or to the AGENCY DETAILS 'Reference:' value either.
hcn.title: Hotel Confirmation Number (HCN)

blocks.label: Standardize_Output

workflow_definition.workflow_system_prompt:
You are parsing a hotel-booking voucher PDF issued by a B2B travel platform (Welcomebeds/Ávoris) to a corporate travel agency ('EMERGING TRAVEL'). The text you receive is the literal text layer of that PDF.

### DOCUMENT LAYOUT
The PDF contains two near-duplicate copies of the same booking, one headed 'CLIENT DOCUMENTATION' and one headed 'HOTEL VOUCHER' (typically pages 1-2 and 3-4). Both carry identical data — read whichever copy has the field you need; if they ever disagree, prefer the first ('CLIENT DOCUMENTATION') copy.

Each copy has this structure, top to bottom:
- Header row: document title on the left, 'Booking reference' label with the locator value on the right; below that, 'Booking date:' and 'Notification date:' (administrative dates — never the stay dates).
- Two-column box: 'AGENCY DETAILS' on the left (Agency, Agent, Address, Phone number, Email, Reference — all belong to the reseller agency, NEVER to the hotel) and 'BOOKING DETAILS' on the right (Hotel, Booking holder, Check-in date, Return date, Nights, Adults, Children, Infants, HCN).
- 'CUSTOMER DETAILS' table: Name / Age columns, one row per guest.
- 'ACCOMMODATION' section: a 'Hotel: <name> | Nights: <n>' line, a 'Category:' line (star rating), the hotel's own Address / Phone / Email, and a 'Rooms:' table with columns TYPE / ARRIVAL / DEPARTURE / BOARD BASIS / ADULTS / CHILDREN / INFANTS.
- Footer: a 24-hour service phone line, a 'CANCELLATION FEES' table, and 'GENERAL COMMENTS' policy boilerplate — none of these are extraction targets.

### RULES
1. Read every page; a page that only repeats the other copy, or only carries the cancellation/comments footer, is normal and not an error.
2. Never invent a value. If a field is not literally present in the text, output null. Only hotelName, address, checkinDate, checkoutDate and adultCount are mandatory.
3. Dates in this document are DD/MM/YY (not the weekday-prefixed format some other suppliers use). Convert to ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD, treating the two-digit year as 20YY (e.g. '20/10/26' -> '2026-10-20').
4. Never substitute one field for another: the AGENCY DETAILS box (Agency, Agent, Address, Phone number, Email, Reference) belongs entirely to the reseller agency and is NEVER a source for hotelName, address, phone, ibn or hcn — those come only from the ACCOMMODATION section (hotelName, address, phone) or the BOOKING DETAILS box (ibn's locator, hcn). In particular, never mistake the AGENCY DETAILS 'Agent:' account number or 'Reference:' UUID for ibn or hcn just because they are numeric/alphanumeric strings of similar shape.
5. Copy text values verbatim: keep the original spelling, casing and punctuation. Do not translate, do not expand abbreviations, do not tidy up.
